Generated by `npx tsx scripts/spriteList.ts` (scope reset phase 3-5); the judged list is `docs/SPRITE_LIST.md`.

794 sprites in 116 families: 437 ok, 260 rework, 18 new, 79 replaced (drawn in code, covered by a painting).
